faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about GlobalUtils

q1.question: What is GlobalUtils?
q1.answer: GlobalUtils is a privacy-first, multi-language utility toolbox providing free online tools for developers and everyday users. All tools work directly in your browser without sending data to external servers.

q2.question: Are these tools really free to use?
q2.answer: Yes! All our tools are completely free to use with no limitations. We believe in providing free access to useful utilities for everyone.

q3.question: Do I need to create an account?
q3.answer: No account required! You can use all our tools anonymously without registration. We don't collect personal data or require sign-up.

q4.question: Is my data safe and private?
q4.answer: Absolutely! All processing happens locally in your browser. We never store, transmit, or have access to your data. This ensures complete privacy and security.

q5.question: Can I use these tools offline?
q5.answer: Yes! Once the page is loaded, most tools work offline because they run entirely in your browser. Only the initial page load requires an internet connection.

q6.question: Do you support mobile devices?
q6.answer: Yes! Our website is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices, tablets, and desktop computers. All tools work seamlessly across all platforms.

q7.question: How do the AI/Smart tools work?
q7.answer: Our smart tools use advanced algorithms and statistical methods to process text and images. They work locally in your browser without needing external APIs. For more powerful AI features, consider using dedicated AI services like ChatGPT.

q8.question: Why don't you use real AI APIs?
q8.answer: We prioritize user privacy and zero costs. Real AI APIs would require sending your data to external servers and incur significant costs. Our current approach provides useful functionality while maintaining complete privacy.

q9.question: Are there any limitations to the smart tools?
q9.answer: Yes, our algorithm-based tools have limitations compared to full AI systems. They work well for basic tasks but may not handle complex semantic understanding. We're transparent about these limitations and continuously improving our algorithms.

q10.question: How often do you add new tools?
q10.answer: We regularly add new tools based on user feedback and needs. Typically, we release 2-4 new tools per month. Follow our updates or join our community to stay informed!

q11.question: Can I request new tools or features?
q11.answer: Absolutely! We welcome user suggestions. Please contact us through our support email, GitHub issues, or Discord community. We prioritize requests based on user demand and technical feasibility.

q12.question: How do you support this free service?
q12.answer: We're supported by non-intrusive advertising (Google AdSense) and optional premium features. Using our tools and sharing our website helps us continue providing free services to everyone.
